To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a neurocomputational model of the locus coereleus system can account for the attention blink, including Lag1 sparing, and that behavioral results from 2 experiments are consistent with a prediction from the model regarding the time course for Lag1 sparing.
the attentional blink may be explained by a refractoriness of locus coeruleus neurons and that the time course of this refractoriness may be related to the time course of attentional blink sparing.
the locus coeruleous is the neural substrate for the attentional-blink effect.

the neural mechanisms underlying the effects of attention on memory and cognition.
the neural mechanisms of attention, particularly those that mediate the effects of arousal and emotion on attentional processing.
